page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the processor demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth, both read and write, fall within the average range. Cryptographic and vector instruction sets, including AVX-512 and SHA extensions, are supported, which assists in accelerating specific mathematical and encryption workloads.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its low memory-to-vCPU ratio and the absence of bundled local storage. This configuration makes it highly cost-efficient for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints or high-speed local disk I/O. It is suitable for tasks such as web serving, batch processing, and single-threaded computational tasks, but less appropriate for large in-memory databases or data-intensive analytics.
